title: Host-object guard is a Symbol.toStringTag tag-string allowlist: Map/URL/spoofed objects nested in event properties skip redaction entirely
evidence:
<> "var ts=Object.prototype.toString.call(o);"
        <> "if(ts!=='[object Object]'&&ts!=='[object Array]')return o;"
        <> "for(var k in o){var v=o[k];"
        <> "if(/resume-token/i.test(k)){o[k]='<redacted>';}"
        <> "else if(typeof v==='string'){o[k]=v.replace(re,'$1<redacted>');}"
detail: Object.prototype.toString.call reads Symbol.toStringTag, settable on any object. Eval probe of the shipped bytes: a plain object holding attr__data-resume-token and a /resume/TOK URL escapes wholesale once given {[Symbol.toStringTag:'Map']}; Map and URL instances also pass through untouched. No producer exists today (token rides the window.__rtResumeToken JS global, never a DOM attribute; page events carry only plain objects/strings), so redaction is safe for the current pipeline — but the guarantee is now silently shape-dependent.
recommended_fix: No in-pipeline producer exists, so the guard is acceptable. Harden cheaply: also require Object.getPrototypeOf(o) in (Object.prototype, null) for the plain-object branch, and pin with a test that Map/URL/toStringTag-spoofed values never reach capture.

title: Stale comment in draft_handler.gleam claims the resume page carries the token in a data-resume-token DOM attribute — the actual mechanism is a JS global
detail: The fix's redaction story depends on the token never being a DOM attribute (form_view.gleam: 'belt-and-braces now the token rides a JS global instead of the DOM'); the resume page renders window.__rtResumeToken and form_pages_test.gleam:336 / draft_integration_test.gleam:316 both assert data-resume-token is absent from the HTML. Acting on the stale comment could re-add the attribute, putting the capability token back inside PostHog autocapture's reach.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to the real mechanism: form_draft.js reads window.__rtResumeToken and posts resume_token in the save payload, which stamps resumed_at via mark_draft_resumed_by_token — never a DOM attribute.
